Spoofing: Unauthorized access to Cortex components or data.
Tampering: Unauthorized modification of data or configuration settings.
Repudiation: Denying the occurrence of certain actions or events within Cortex.
Information Disclosure: Unauthorized access to sensitive information within Cortex.
Denial Of Service: Disrupting or degrading the availability of Cortex services.
Elevation Of Privilege: Unauthorized escalation of user privileges within Cortex.
